mentions.name: Neighborhood Quality Map
mentions.description: This app provides an interactive map that shows which neighborhoods in a city are nice or not nice, each with a short description. It uses AI-generated scoring and descriptions, and early users can submit corrections to improve accuracy.
mentions.problem: When visiting a new city, Google Maps is pretty meaningless — just gray land and streets — so people end up searching Reddit posts, crime maps, and annotated maps to figure out where to visit or live.
mentions.audience: People visiting a new city or deciding where to live there.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a map that shows which neighborhoods in a city are nice/not nice with a short description.
